title: FIPS-199 Categorization
description:
It's the official categorization of your system's security impact level. You assess three dimensions:
||Dimension||Question||CSFEER Likely Rating||
|*Confidentiality*|What's the impact if data is disclosed to unauthorized people?|Moderate (PII of tribal recipients)|
|*Integrity*|What's the impact if data is modified or destroyed?|Moderate (reporting data accuracy matters)|
|*Availability*|What's the impact if the system goes down?|Low (not life-safety critical)|

Why it matters: The categorization determines which NIST 800-53 security controls you have to implement. A "Moderate" system has ~325 controls vs. ~125 for "Low" - significantly more documentation and security work.

This is typically one of the first ATO artifacts completed because everything else flows from it.

Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability impact levels assessed and justified; Overall system categorization documented (expected: Moderate); Categorization approved by ACF ISSO; Form submitted using NIST template

*Acceptance Criteria:*

- PostgreSQL database configured for Keycloak data persistence  
- Keycloak admin user created with proper credentials
- Service accessible on localhost:8081
- Health checks implemented for service readiness

*Technical Details:*
- Image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:latest
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 with dedicated schema
- Admin credentials: admin/admin
- Ports: 127.0.0.1:8081:8081 (restricted to localhost)
- Volume mounts for realm configuration import
- Security hardening with no-new-privileges and capability drops

title: SPIKE: Parse fillable fields from PDF
description:
Example code to grab all the form fields in a PDF and parse them into dicts:




 

```
import pdfplumber
from pdfplumber.utils.pdfinternals import resolve_and_decode

pdf = pdfplumber.open("/Users/ryanbagwell/Downloads/FY24-CSBG-Tribal-Annual-Report-Short-Form-Fillable-PDF-Tool_2.pdf")

fields = pdf.doc.catalog["AcroForm"].resolve().get("Fields")


def get_field_flags(flags: int | None):

positions= {
"read_only": 0,
"required": 1,
"no_export": 2,
"multiline": 13,
"password": 14,
"file_select": 15,
"multiselect": 22,
}

ifnotflags:
return \{k: Falsefork, _inpositions.items()}
 
bits=list((flags).to_bytes(32))

return \{k: bits[v] ==1fork, vinpositions.items()}


for field in fields:

data=field.resolve()

parsed= {
"type": resolve_and_decode(data.get("FT")),
"label": resolve_and_decode(data.get("TU") ordata.get("T")),
"name": resolve_and_decode(data.get("TM")),
"default_value": resolve_and_decode(data.get("DV")),
"choices": resolve_and_decode(data.get("Op")),
}

field_flags=resolve_and_decode(data.get("Ff"))

parsed.update(get_field_flags(resolve_and_decode(data.get("Ff"))))

print(parsed)

```

[Research plan_Usability Testing|https://docs.google.com/document/d/1l4ZwPA2aaoH1G-L3xkOxsx8TSFr7sSvI5Neufqp9Jwc/edit?tab=t.31kdim8nkbq7#heading=h.7oachd2yik1v]

title: Security Assessment Plan (SAP)
description:
Document the approach for assessing CSFEER security controls per NIST SP 800-53A.

Assessment scope defined (Moderate baseline controls); Methodology documented (interview, examine, test); Assessor identified; SAP approved by ACF ISSO

title: Security Assessment Report (SAR)
description:
Security Assessment Report (SAR)

Document results of security control assessment identifying findings and risk levels per NIST SP 800-53A.

All controls have documented results; Findings described with evidence; Risk ratings assigned (High/Moderate/Low); Overall system risk documented; SAR reviewed with ISSO

title: Interconnection Security Agreement (ISA)
description:
Document security requirements for CSFEER interconnections per NIST SP 800-47, including Login.gov and any upstream ACF systems

All interconnections identified; Security responsibilities defined for each party; Data exchanged and sensitivity documented; ISA signed by authorized officials

title: POA&M (Plan of Action & Milestones)
description:
Track security findings and remediation per HHS standards. High-risk within 30 days, medium within 60 days per PWS.

All SAR findings entered; Remediation actions defined; Milestones and dates established; Responsible parties assigned; Format follows HHS standards

title: Contingency Plan + Test Report
description:
Execute and document contingency plan test per NIST SP 800-34 to validate recovery procedures work as documented.

Test executed (tabletop or functional); Results documented including failures; Lessons learned captured; Action items identified; Contingency Plan updated based on findings

title: E-Authentication Questionnaire
description:
Complete E-Authentication Threshold Analysis per OMB 04-04 and NIST SP 800-63 to determine assurance levels for CSFEER authentication.

E-Auth Threshold Analysis completed; IAL and AAL determined and documented; Login.gov integration aligns with assurance levels; Documentation approved by ACF ISSO
